requirements_summary: Primary workload: real-time user-facing chat with fast reranking of suggestions (embedding + cross-encoder rerank).
Traffic profile: steady bursts 50-300 TPS; tight p95 latency objective for interactive UX (goal p95 < 80ms).
Cost sensitivity: target <$0.50 per 1k responses equivalent across average session length; open to reserved capacity if unit costs justify.
Model preferences: prefer open/quantized variants (LLaMA-family or similar) to avoid large token costs; willing to try int8/4-bit quantization if quality holds.
Routing/fallback: multi-tier routing desired (fast small model for strict latency, higher-quality model fallback for edge cases).
Observability: token-level cost/latency breakdown, per-route traces, and eval-driven regression alerts required.
Security & compliance: SAML SSO, KMS/HSM for keys, audit logs retained 13 months, data residency (US) for customer data.
Deployment: VPC-first for production; PoC can run hosted/dedicated to prove SLOs.
perf_benchmark_requests: Run synthetic perf harness: 10k warmup + 50k steady requests with realistic prompt length distribution (median tokens=32, 95th=120).
Measure p50/p90/p95/p99 tail latencies and cost per 1M tokens for: hosted baseline, dedicated 4xA100 pool, and quantized int8 model on dedicated pool.
Compare batching strategies: client-side batching vs server continuous batching (batch size sweep: 1, 2, 4, 8) and impact on p95 and per-token cost.
Test KV/prefix caching effectiveness for repeated conversational prefixes; measure hit rate and latency delta.
Validate graceful fallback: route to smaller quantized model when capacity saturated and measure quality regression (BLEU/ROUGE proxies + human spot checks).
